name: accountable-surface
description: Accountable actuation over MCP: witnessed perception, a pre-execution gate (allow/deny/needs-human), a reach-bounded act, an independent self-verify (MATCH/DRIFT/UNVERIFIABLE), a tamper-evident journal, and an offline-re-derivable action receipt. Read-only device ls is wired today; write-class actuation and broad browser/app/device breadth are target, not shipped.

runtime.note: The JSON-RPC protocol layer is stdlib only (no FastMCP). initialize, tools/list, status, and doctor answer even without the action runtime; the action tools load it lazily and return a named error when it is absent.

env.ACCOUNTABLE_SURFACE_GRANTS: Path to the operator's authorization-grant JSON. Without a grant naming an action_kind, actuation is default-deny. The model never supplies authorization.
env.ACCOUNTABLE_SURFACE_JOURNAL: Optional path to the append-only, hash-chained journal. Unset keeps the surface in-memory.
env.ACCOUNTABLE_SURFACE_RECEIPTS: Optional path to the append-only action-receipt/v1 store. Defaults beside the journal, else a per-process temp file.
env.ACCOUNTABLE_SURFACE_NATIVE_CONTROL_SCRIP: Path to the telos native-control.mjs actuator. Required to actuate device ls for real; unset yields a clean refusal.
